caption: The drawing depicts a formal men's suit, consisting of a long black coat, waistcoat, and knee-breeches. The coat features elaborate floral embroidery in green, white, and yellow along the edges, cuffs, and collar, as well as a magenta stripe bordering the embroidery. The waistcoat beneath is a light pastel color with its own floral embroidery in similar shades of green, pink, and yellow. The front of the shirt is decorated with a detailed white lace or ruffled cravat. The knee-breeches match the coat in black and have buttons on the outer leg. The interior lining of the coat appears light blue. A detailed rear view sketch of the coat, rendered in grey pencil or ink, is located in the upper right corner, showing the back seams and floral embroidery that runs up the center and decorates the cuffs and lower hem. The drawing is rendered on a beige background.
title: Man's Court Costume
